proof.criterion: Acceptance 5 — the daemon removes the right workspaces at the right time: done root and done child removed, unfinished child kept with a log line, backlog/icebox root kept with no jj command, a failed removal logged once and the tree still closed, no removal at linger start, a root admitted mid-close provisions only after the close and that close removes nothing
proof.surface: ProcessManager.closeTree / beginLinger / admit through the fake tmux runtime and command recorder (the daemon's own test harness), with a real scratch stateDir whose fake clone has .jj and real workspace directories
proof.command: cd packages/daemon && LEGION_E2E=1 bun test src/daemon/__tests__/processes.test.ts -t "workspaces of a done root|parked root's workspace|failed workspace removal|no workspace removal at linger|admitted while its previous tree"
proof.observed: 5 pass. The done root and done child recorded 'jj workspace forget legion-42' and 'legion-43' plus 'jj abandon -r aaaa | bbbb --ignore-working-copy -R <clone>', every jj command after the last tmux stop, their directories deleted and the in_progress grandchild's kept, exactly three 'workspace of' log lines (two removed…abandoned 2 commit(s) nothing else reached, one kept…Dispatch status "in_progress"); backlog and icebox roots closed with zero jj/git commands, the directory intact and the kept line; a failing abandon produced exactly one 'failed to remove the workspace of …' line carrying the error (Revision `aaaa` doesn't exist), the directory already gone, no forget, tree closed; beginLinger ran no jj/git command; the reopened root's spawn logged 'launch of LEGION-42 waits for the close of tree LEGION-42 to finish' and ran no jj command until the close settled, the close logged 'kept every workspace of tree LEGION-42 at its close: the tree record is "active", not lingering (re-admitted while closing)', ran no forget or abandon, and every provisioning jj command (update-stale first) came after the close.
proof.negativeControl: The same five tests on the pre-implementation daemon: four failed (forgotten [] instead of ['legion-42','legion-43']; no kept line for backlog; no failed-removal semantics; provisioning's update-stale ran before the close settled) and only the linger-start guard passed, as it must. The failing-abandon test is itself a negative control on the removal: a non-zero jj exit stops the sequence before forget and prune.

trickyParts: The rebase GitHub's CONFLICTING forced: LEGION-15 removed flushEventLoopUntil, so the fifth daemon test now awaits the root stop arming its timeout sleep through a gate its own sleep fake resolves, and its one remaining tick-budget drain carries the required '// Negative wait:' line; the three console.error spies now restore in a finally, because a later test (LEGION-107's receipt_timeout) counts console.error calls and a spy left in place made it inherit this branch's three lines.

workspaceCommandRunner is a class field (the daemon runner with stderr normalised), shared by provisionWorkspace and removeWorkspace, typed as the workspace package's own run so both functions accept it unchanged.

removeIssueWorkspace asks jj only when <clone>/.jj exists, so a tree that closes without ever having provisioned logs nothing; every existing daemon close test under config('/state') therefore records no new command and no pin needed extending.
deviations: The plan expected 5 daemon tests to fail before the implementation; 4 did. 'runs no workspace removal at linger start' passes on today's code because beginLinger has never removed anything — it is a guard against moving the removal there, which the spec's acceptance 5 names explicitly, so it is kept.

The plan's test-file argv helpers (abandonCommand, forgetCommand, pruneCommand, ownCommitsCommand) were inlined into the one exact-pin expectation per the repository's tiny-functions rule; workspaceListCommand (three call sites) and gitWorktrees (asserts) stay.
